text: Which NK-cell-specific genes (blood immune cells) are not enriched in the T-cell lineage?
plan: Immune cell category (RNA): NK-cell / Immune cell enriched AND NOT Immune cell lineage category (RNA): T-cells / Lineage enriched, Group enriched
understanding: Identify genes that are specifically expressed/enriched in NK-cells within blood immune cells, but exclude genes that are enriched in the T-cell lineage.

trail.why: NK-cell-specific genes are those categorized as 'Immune cell enriched' in NK-cells, defined as having at least four-fold higher mRNA levels in NK-cells compared to any other immune cell type.

trail.requirement: not enriched in the T-cell lineage
trail.why: Enrichment in a lineage encompasses both lineage-specific enrichment and group enrichment sharing that lineage.

requirements.why: This field specifically classifies RNA specificity across 18 flow-sorted immune cell types from blood, including NK-cell specificity/enrichment.

requirements.requirement: not enriched in the T-cell lineage
requirements.why: This field defines RNA specificity across the 6 immune cell lineages (specifically T-cells and Lineage enriched), which is negated to exclude genes enriched in the T-cell lineage.
